subject: se
question: Draw a UML Class Diagram for a Library Management System using the classes Student, Book, Librarian, Issue Record and Fine, with attributes, methods, relationships and multiplicities.
title: The Issue Record Hub
hook: A class is just a blank form: the details it holds, and the things it can do.
answer: A class box has three parts: name / attributes (-) / methods (+).
Associations (plain lines): Student borrows IssueRecord, Librarian creates IssueRecord, IssueRecord is for Book, IssueRecord gets Fine.
Multiplicities: Student 1 to 0..* IssueRecord; Librarian 1 to 0..* IssueRecord; Book 1 to 0..* IssueRecord; IssueRecord 1 to 0..1 Fine.
Memory trick: the IssueRecord is the hub of the wheel.
